root_cause: Without Git attributes, Windows core.autocrlf=true changed LF to CRLF in eight original CSVs and generation_metadata.json. Every reproduced checkout hash exactly equals the corresponding failed CI hash, and every committed blob still equals its pre-existing manifest SHA-256.
fix: Disable Git text normalization for data/*.csv and data/generation_metadata.json, preserving exact committed bytes.
limitation: Individual feature attribution can shift between collinear DistrictKey_1 and Sector_Central across platforms; predictions, metrics, district summaries, and grouped importances match within the unchanged validation tolerances.
